subject: Acme - Request for DPA and current subprocessor list / notification of subprocessor change
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@acme-corp.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@acme-corp.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: DPA copy and current subprocessor roster

Hi Karthik / Monica,

We're in the final stage of procurement for the Acme integration and need a couple of items to close the legal review:

- Executed copy of Redwood's DPA between Acme and Redwood (DocuSign or PDF).
- A current list of subprocessors with country of operation and data processing purpose.
- Confirmation of transfer mechanisms for EU/UK personal data (SCC, UK Addendum, or adequacy).

Can you also flag if there are any planned subprocessor changes in the next 30 days? Procurement would like at least 30 days' notice for new subprocessors.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Senior Procurement Specialist
Acme Corporation

--
Elena Ruiz
Acme Corporation
Phone: +1-212-555-0147
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: DPA copy and current subprocessor roster

Hi Elena — thanks for the note. Attaching the current subprocessor roster (PDF) and a copy of the executed DPA we have on file for Acme.

Quick answers in-line:
- Executed DPA: attached (dpa_executed_acme_20251210.pdf).
- Subprocessor roster: attached (redwood_subprocessors_20260115.pdf) — includes country and processing purpose per vendor.
- Transfer mechanism: Redwood relies on the EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) plus the UK Addendum where applicable; we can confirm country-by-country if you need specifics.

One heads-up: our infra team is planning to onboard a CDN partner to reduce latency in APAC and EMEA (internal name: EdgeScale). If you require formal notice before onboarding we can treat this as a subprocessor change notification and provide the onboarding package.

Looping in Naomi from Legal and Marissa from Security for any contract or security questions.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: dpa_executed_acme_20251210.pdf, redwood_subprocessors_20260115.pdf

Subject: Re: Request: DPA copy and current subprocessor roster

Hi Elena — Naomi from Legal here. Thanks for the request and for the quick procurement timeline. A few clarifications and confirmations: 

- The attached roster is the authoritative list as of 2026-01-15. Vendors are grouped by function (hosting, monitoring, analytics, CDN, etc.) with country of processing and a short note on why the vendor processes data.
- Transfer mechanisms: we have SCCs in place with our subprocessor vendors that process EU/UK personal data; we also apply the UK Addendum when UK residency applies. For a handful of vendors in adequacy countries we rely on adequacy where applicable — details are in the roster.
- Planned change: as Karthik noted, we intend to onboard a CDN partner (EdgeScale) to improve global delivery. The plan is to add EdgeScale as a subprocessor; onboarding is targeted for 2026-02-01 pending contract and security review.

If Acme requires an executed amendment or explicit prior approval for subprocessor additions, let us know and we can treat EdgeScale as a formal change request. Otherwise we will provide the standard 30-day notification and the vendor's security questionnaire and SOC audit summary once contract is signed.

Naomi Feldman
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security
Redwood Inference

Thanks Naomi / Karthik — this is helpful. Procurement has two follow-ups:

1) We need a DocuSign copy of the executed DPA for our records (the PDF is fine, DocuSign preferred).
2) We require 30 days' notice for new subprocessors. Please provide the EdgeScale onboarding packet (SOC report, network diagrams, contact point, and a short memo on the nature of data they will process).

Also copying our security team (security@acme-corp.com) — they'll run the standard vendor assessment. If you can supply the vendor questionnaire responses and the SOC summary by EOD Friday that would help speed approval.

Best,
Elena

Elena — quick update and formal notification.

Per our internal timelines and the standard notification process, Redwood will add EdgeScale (EdgeScale Inc., data centers in US, EU, APAC) as a subprocessor effective 2026-02-01. Attached is the EdgeScale onboarding sheet with: vendor contacts, expected processing types (CDN cache and edge delivery only), SOC summary excerpt, and a short risk memo. Full SOC and questionnaire responses will be shared via secure link once contract is executed.

If Acme requires an executed amendment to the DPA (rather than notice), please advise and we will route for signature; otherwise the DPA terms already cover subprocessor additions and we will provide the 30-day notice as requested.

Links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/ACME-OP-2026-43) & SEC ticket (https://redwood-inference.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-142) — tracking both procurement approval and security review.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30-minute call if your team wants to review EdgeScale details live.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
